observation: Flag cloth does not exhibit the strong wind-driven deformation described in the brief.
expected_behavior: With a steady strong breeze from screen-left, the flag should billow outward in deep rolling waves with sharper flutter and snapping toward the trailing edge while remaining fully attached along the hoist side.
actual_behavior: The rendered flag appears mostly flat with only mild curvature, limited wave amplitude, and no convincing trailing-edge flutter or snap. Motion cues are weak even in the still frame.
